name: find_location
title: Find a location
description: Resolve a Canadian place name (town, park, lake, mountain, river) or coordinates to matching places and the nearest Environment Canada forecast sites. Other tools accept the same location text, so call this only when a name is ambiguous (check type and province) or to see which forecast site covers a remote spot.

location.description: Place name, optionally with a province ("Garibaldi, BC"). Omit when giving lat and lon.

province.description: Only places in this province or territory: code or name ("AB").

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.

name: get_forecast
title: Get the weather forecast
description: Environment Canada's forecast for the nearest forecast site: current conditions, the official forecast by period (today, tonight, then about 6 days, with snow levels in the mountains where ECCC issues them), an hourly forecast, sunrise and sunset, and active warning headlines. The result names the site and its distance. For full alert text use get_alerts.

location.description: A place in Canada: town, park, lake, peak or river, optionally with a province ("Squamish", "Lake Louise, AB", "Mont-Tremblant, QC"). Ignored when lat and lon are given.

hours.description: Hourly forecast entries to include (0 to omit).

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

location.description: The point the result is for.

forecast_site.description: The forecast site used and its distance.

normals.description: The period's normal temperatures, as ECCC words them.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.

name: get_alerts
title: Get weather alerts
description: Active Environment Canada weather alerts (warnings, watches, advisories, statements) for a location, with the official text as issued. "alerts" are those whose area contains the point; "nearby_alerts" are brief entries for areas within a few km. An empty "alerts" list means none in effect. Quote alert text as given.

location.description: A place in Canada: town, park, lake, peak or river, optionally with a province ("Squamish", "Lake Louise, AB", "Mont-Tremblant, QC"). Ignored when lat and lon are given.

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

location.description: The point the result is for.

alerts.description: Alerts whose area contains the point, most severe first.

nearby_alerts.description: Brief entries for alerts in areas within a few km.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.

name: get_current_observations
title: Get current weather observations
description: The latest measured weather at the Environment Canada and NAV CANADA stations nearest a location (within 50 km): temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind and gusts, pressure, visibility, cloud cover, precipitation over the past 1, 6 and 24 hours, snowfall and snow depth. Stations report different sets of readings; readings that failed ECCC's quality checks are left out, and one missing from the newest report may come from an older report (earlier_readings gives its time). For the forecast use get_forecast.

location.description: A place in Canada: town, park, lake, peak or river, optionally with a province ("Squamish", "Lake Louise, AB", "Mont-Tremblant, QC"). Ignored when lat and lon are given.

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

location.description: The point the result is for.

stations.description: The nearest reporting stations, closest first.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.

name: get_river_conditions
title: Get river levels and flows
description: Real-time water level (m) and flow (m3/s) at the Water Survey of Canada gauges nearest a location (within 50 km), with the change over 24 hours, the range over 3 days, and today's flow against the historical mean for this month. river keeps only gauges whose name contains it. Data are provisional and can be affected by ice; compare a level only with the same gauge. This is not a flood forecast: use get_alerts for warnings.

location.description: A place in Canada: town, park, lake, peak or river, optionally with a province ("Squamish", "Lake Louise, AB", "Mont-Tremblant, QC"). Ignored when lat and lon are given.

river.description: Only gauges whose name contains this text ("Bow River").

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

location.description: The point the result is for.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.

name: get_air_quality
title: Get air quality
description: The Air Quality Health Index (AQHI, 1 to 10+, higher is worse) at the nearest AQHI location (within 100 km): the latest hourly observation and the forecast for today, tonight, tomorrow and later, each with its risk category and health messages for the general population and for people at risk.

location.description: A place in Canada: town, park, lake, peak or river, optionally with a province ("Squamish", "Lake Louise, AB", "Mont-Tremblant, QC"). Ignored when lat and lon are given.

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

location.description: The point the result is for.

health_messages.description: Health messages, once per risk category.

health_messages_source.description: Where the health messages come from.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.

name: get_snow_outlook
title: Get the snow outlook
description: Model guidance for snow at a point over the next 12, 24 or 48 hours, in four steps: the snow level (metres above sea level below which snow turns to rain, HRDPS 2.5 km), new snow as water equivalent (mm, RDPS 10 km) with an estimate in cm, and the probability of blowing snow. Raw model output, not a forecaster's forecast or an avalanche bulletin; for text forecasts use get_forecast.

location.description: A place in Canada: town, park, lake, peak or river, optionally with a province ("Squamish", "Lake Louise, AB", "Mont-Tremblant, QC"). Ignored when lat and lon are given.

hours.description: How far ahead to look: 12, 24 or 48 hours.

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

location.description: The point the result is for.

steps.description: The steps, each with its snow level, new snow and blowing snow probability.

total_new_snow_water_mm.description: New snow over all steps, as water equivalent.

total_new_snow_cm_estimate.description: The same in cm of snow at snow_to_liquid_ratio.

snow_to_liquid_ratio.description: Snow depth to water depth used for the cm estimates (10 means 10:1).

model_runs.description: The model runs the values come from.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.

name: get_marine_forecast
title: Get the marine forecast
description: Environment Canada's marine forecast for the marine area at a location (coastal waters, large lakes, Arctic waters): wind in knots, weather and visibility, waves, air temperature and freezing spray for today and tomorrow, the extended wind forecast, and marine warnings in effect. A point on land gets the nearest areas within 25 km. Quote warnings as given. For alerts on land use get_alerts.

location.description: A place in Canada: town, park, lake, peak or river, optionally with a province ("Squamish", "Lake Louise, AB", "Mont-Tremblant, QC"). Ignored when lat and lon are given.

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

location.description: The point the result is for.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.

name: get_climate_context
title: Get climate normals and records
description: Climate context for a location and date, to judge whether a forecast is unusual: the daily records for that calendar day (highest and lowest temperatures, most precipitation and snowfall, with the year of each) from the nearest long-term climate station (within 100 km), and the monthly 1981-2010 climate normals at the nearest normals station (within 50 km). The stations are usually in valleys and towns, so mountain conditions differ. date defaults to today.

location.description: A place in Canada: town, park, lake, peak or river, optionally with a province ("Squamish", "Lake Louise, AB", "Mont-Tremblant, QC"). Ignored when lat and lon are given.

date.description: The calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD or MM-DD (the year is ignored). Defaults to today.

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

location.description: The point the result is for.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.

name: get_radar_map
title: Get the weather radar map
description: The latest weather radar around a location (updated every 6 minutes): a 512x512 PNG of precipitation over a base map with the location ringed in red, plus the radar's rain and snow rates at the point, the surface precipitation type, and the rate 30 and 60 minutes ago. radius_km sets the area (25 to 200 km); precipitation picks the colour scale (see legend), by default snow from November to April. Radar can miss precipitation below the beam in mountains and far from radars, and can show echoes that do not reach the ground.

location.description: A place in Canada: town, park, lake, peak or river, optionally with a province ("Squamish", "Lake Louise, AB", "Mont-Tremblant, QC"). Ignored when lat and lon are given.

radius_km.description: Distance from the point to the map's edges.

precipitation.description: The map's colour scale: rain or snow.

include_image.description: Return the map image too. false gives only the readings, with fewer upstream requests.

lang.description: Language of text fields: en or fr.

location.description: The point the result is for.

observed_at.description: When the radar frame is from.

at_point.description: Rain and snow rates and the precipitation type at the point.

map.description: The image's area, size and legend.

note.description: Anything the caller should know about this result.

attribution.description: The data credit to pass on.
